The grenade's damage scales with how full the magazine is (page), and this entry always fires the full-magazine grenade. Every later shot in a magazine reads high unless the rifle is reloaded first, which is how it is played.
The alt-fire cannot be reloaded early to skip its delay, and Kinetic Ricochet does not affect it; the sim does not interrupt reloads, so neither changes anything here.

Primary Compression's row for this attack is not entered. The table reads '127% / Both / Merged': over 100% effectiveness, both stacking brackets at once, and a fourth kind of radius calculation. The engine has no place for that combination, so the arcane adds nothing on this form here, where in game it is worth more than on the primary fire.
